blocks.text: Ethical research makes findings trustworthy and respects the rights of those involved. Following ethical guidelines avoids harm, misinformation and unfairness, and makes results credible and useful to others. Falsifying data or copying others' work without credit (plagiarism) is unethical: it leads to wrong conclusions and damages the researcher's reputation.
